inference_source: Deterministic simulation; no model inference or model-quality claim.

dataset.source: Manually reviewed synthetic teaching examples; not customer data.
dataset.note: Development examples may be inspected during improvement.

limitations: Small synthetic dataset; does not establish real-world or production performance.
Urgency follows this project's teaching policy, not a validated support organization policy.
Summary correctness is not evaluated by category/urgency metrics.
A single run does not establish repeated-run reliability or operational latency guarantees.

category.zero_denominator_policy: Per-class precision/recall/F1 are 0 when undefined; macro uses all labels.

urgency.zero_denominator_policy: Per-class precision/recall/F1 are 0 when undefined; macro uses all labels.

latency_seconds.scope: Attempted prediction calls, including failures; excludes unattempted cases and setup.

token_usage.note: Only returned usage is counted. Missing usage or failed requests does not imply zero billing.

cost_note: Not calculated: no explicit verified price schedule is supplied.
